describe: make something happen when the player touches something that is already in the game
guide: Inside the loop, after things have moved, check player.colliderect(thing) -- or player.collidelist(list) for many -- and do what should happen right there. Those are true on every frame the two overlap, so a point, a hit or a lost life must happen once per touch: move the thing away, or in a game with a scene use scene.touched(player, things), which is true only in the frame a touch begins.
report: Now when the player touches a $noun, $what.
I added a check for the player touching a $noun -- when it happens, $what.
teach: colliderect is true when two rectangles overlap, so the check runs every frame and fires the moment they touch.
